question: 单项选择：_____ he _____ to the cinema yesterday? A. Does, go  B. Did, went  C. Did, go  D. Was, go
answer: 答案：C. Did, go。解析：yesterday是一般过去时。did是助动词，后面的动词必须用原形。

question: 句型转换：She watched TV last night. （改为一般疑问句）
answer: 答案：Did she watch TV last night? 解析：一般过去时一般疑问句的结构是Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？watched要还原为原形watch。

question: 单项选择：Tom _____ come to school yesterday because he was ill. A. doesn't  B. isn't  C. didn't  D. wasn't
answer: 答案：C. didn't。解析：yesterday是一般过去时。主语Tom是第三人称单数，但didn't是助动词did的否定形式，didn't后接动词原形come。

question: 句型转换：I played football yesterday. （改为否定句）
answer: 答案：I didn't play football yesterday. 解析：一般过去时否定句结构：主语 + didn't + 动词原形 + 其他。played还原为play。

question: 单项选择：_____ you _____ the book last week? A. Do, read  B. Did, read  C. Did, readed  D. Were, read
answer: 答案：B. Did, read。解析：last week是一般过去时。一般疑问句用Did + 主语 + 动词原形，read的过去式是read，但did之后必须用原形。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：They ______ (not, see) the movie last night.
answer: 答案：didn't see。解析：last night是一般过去时。否定句用didn't + 动词原形。see的过去式是saw，但在didn't后用原形see。

question: 单项选择：When _____ you _____ your homework this morning? A. did, finish  B. did, finished  C. do, finish  D. were, finish
answer: 答案：A. did, finish。解析：this morning是一般过去时。特殊疑问句用疑问词 + 助动词did + 主语 + 动词原形。

question: 句型转换：Did you go to the park? （作否定回答）
answer: 答案：No, I didn't. 解析：一般过去时一般疑问句的否定回答用No, 主语 + didn't。

question: 单项选择：He _____ buy any books yesterday. A. doesn't  B. didn't  C. don't  D. wasn't
answer: 答案：B. didn't。解析：yesterday是一般过去时。一般过去时否定句：主语 + didn't + 动词原形。

question: 句型转换：I saw the film yesterday. （改为一般疑问句并作肯定回答）
answer: 答案：Did you see the film yesterday? Yes, I did. 解析：一般过去时一般疑问句用Did开头；saw还原为see。肯定回答用Yes, I did。
